data.body: Classification: llm-behavioral (Instruction Locality #16 + Validator Permissiveness). Root cause: (1) The Step 4 HARD-GATE reviewer list is co-located with dispatch decision site making it maximally salient; the pipeline execution directive at Steps 2.5/2.6/2.75 is 1 line after a substitution-prohibition block, structurally unreachable when orchestrator reaches Step 4 dispatch moment. (2) The PIL validator accepts any 3-field PIL body - the orchestrator can satisfy the validator by writing the template without executing the pipeline. Score: N/A (llm-behavioral path). Fix plan: (1) Add Gap analysis (Step 1) field to PIL template + REQUIRED_FIELDS in ticket-lib.sh to make the validator reject PILs missing Step 1 execution evidence; (2) Add step-local execution checklist to brainstorm SKILL.md at Steps 2.5 dispatch site. testing_mode=RED
